result.description: A fictional compact field recorder designed for podcasters, sound designers, and journalists who need a simple, pocketable capture device for spoken-word recording, ambient sound notes, and quick transfers to a laptop or phone. The Harbor H2 uses an internal flash-based archive and USB-C connectivity for bus-powered file offload, but it is not intended as a gaming drive, enterprise SSD, or graphics component. Its quiet chassis, dual microphone inputs, and onboard normalization tools make it suitable for low-profile studio work and mobile interviews.
